basic_profile.bio: Hailing from the Pacific Northwest, I'm a 32-year-old automotive enthusiast and proud owner of a Subaru Outback, which I've lovingly nicknamed 'The Adventure Wagon.' During the weekdays, I work as a systems analyst for a tech company. In my free time, I love tinkering with my car, exploring curly hair care routines, and engaging in deep discussions on niche topics. I'm happily married to my high school sweetheart, and we enjoy exploring the great outdoors with our two rescue dogs. My typical online hours are evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a degree from a well-regarded university, which has been further honed through years of hands-on experience in the tech industry. My knowledge of automotive maintenance and repair stems from both self-taught methods and participation in local car clubs. Additionally, my expertise in curly hair care has been developed through extensive research and personal experimentation.
